questions.question: Which cloud benefit refers to the ability of a system to recover from failures and continue to function?

options.why: Elasticity is automatic scaling with demand.
Predictability is about consistent performance and cost.
Agility is about speed of provisioning and change.

questions.explanation: Reliability is the ability to recover from failures and keep functioning.

questions.question: How does the cloud's decentralised design improve reliability?

options.text: It lets you deploy resources in multiple regions and zones, so a failure in one location does not stop the service
It guarantees that hardware never fails
options.why: Hardware fails; the design tolerates it.

options.text: It removes the need for backups
It puts all resources in one large datacenter
options.why: That would be centralised, the opposite.

questions.explanation: Global distribution of regions and zones enables failover and recovery.

questions.question: Which Azure service replicates on-premises or Azure VMs to another location so they can fail over during a disaster?
questions.explanation: Azure Site Recovery provides replication and orchestrated failover for disaster recovery.

questions.question: A business states it can tolerate losing at most 15 minutes of data after a disaster. What is this requirement called?

options.why: Correct. RPO is the acceptable data loss measured in time.
RTO is how quickly service must be restored.
TCO is about cost, not data loss.

questions.explanation: RPO defines acceptable data loss; RTO defines acceptable downtime.
